messages.subject: warning messgages in final
parts:
Dear friends,
  My device is GT9X. I put g.shell,GGIR code in R. However I received warnings in the final:

Warning messages:

1: In g.shell.GGIR(mode = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), datadir = "C:/myfolder/mydata/.....",  :

Argument excludefirstlast has been provided more than once. Try to avoid this.

2: In g.part4_extractid(params_general[["idloc"]], fname = fnames[i],  :

Sleeplog id is stored as format: 123, while

                           code expects format: data


I got results in the last, but is there any wrong?

messages.author: 5ea25187985f565f
messages.subject: Re: warning messgages in final
parts:
Hi,

Can you post the call you made to GGIR, and the format of your sleep log?

The problem in warning 1 should be fairly obvious - `excludefirstlast` is used more than once. It shouldn't have caused any issues (unless they were different).

For warning 2, your sleep log needs to match the format given in the vignette. You may also need to specify "colid" to tell GGIR which column has the ID number. If GGIR hasn't been able to use your sleep log, it will have fallen back to automatic sleep detection. You can check if this happened in your data by seeing if the variable "sleeplog_used" is zero (your sleeplog was not used) or one (it was used).

Taren
